note: measured from the LOD0 GLBs as they are; nothing was changed. Fix at source and re-run.

recommended.metallic: exactly 0 (dielectric) or 1 (metal); in-between only on mixed texels (rust, dirt, edges)
recommended.glass: metallic 0, roughness 0.0-0.1, base colour near white with alphaMode BLEND or KHR_materials_transmission; IOR 1.5
recommended.emissive: emissive materials are exempt from albedo limits; emissive strength in nits/lux needs scene exposure context
references: Unreal/Substance PBR guide: dielectric sRGB 50-240, metals 180-255 sRGB
